channel.title: Latch
channel.description: Updates for Latch, a grid window manager for macOS.

item.title: Latch 1.0.5
item.description:
• Latch now asks for a trigger during setup, and waits for it. A new install no longer changes what dragging a window does until you ask it to — the zones appear when you hold your trigger, and Settings has the switch for showing them on every drag. Existing setups keep the behaviour they already had.
  • The right-button trigger is named for what it actually is: a mouse button. A trackpad cannot send a secondary click part-way through a drag, so the two-finger click it used to promise was never going to work.
